description_en: Queries the program list of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-caster-program --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --episode-id 1872639A-F203-4EC5-8E43-CB92E68F0000 --episode-type Resource --start-time 2016-06-29T09:00:00Z --end-time 2016-06-29T10:00:00Z --page-num 5 --page-size 10 --status 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCasterProgram

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the LIVE console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. To go to this page, choose LIVE > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC

parameters.name: page_size
